name: TPS54360
description: 60 V, 3.5 A non-synchronous buck with Eco-mode, for robots running on 24 V, 36 V or 48 V packs that need a few amps of 5 V or 12 V.
notes: Non-synchronous: needs an external 60 V Schottky diode (e.g. B560C).
RT resistor sets 100 kHz–2.5 MHz (500 kHz with 200 kΩ); external compensation on COMP.
Solder the PowerPAD to GND with thermal vias.

en.note: Internal pull-up I1 = 1.2 µA (float = enabled) plus Ihys = 3.4 µA sourced once EN > 1.2 V. Threshold 1.2 V (1.1-1.3). Abs max 8.4 V, so never tie EN to VIN. The typical app µses a UVLO divider: RUVLO1 = 523k (VIN-EN), RUVLO2 = 84.5k (EN-GND) for 8 V start / 6.25 V stop. Eq.4 RUVLO1 = (VSTART - VSTOP)/Ihys; Eq.5 RUVLO2 = VENA / ((VSTART - VENA)/RUVLO1 + I1). If a low-start divider would push EN above 8.4 V at high VIN, add a zener clamp on EN. For always-on, leave EN floating.

comp.note: gmea = 350 µA/V (EA transconductance, normal operation; 77 µA/V in EC / 78 µA/V in text during soft-start). gmps = 12 A/V (COMP-to-SW current). EA dc gain 10,000 V/V, min unity-gain BW 2500 kHz, source/sink +/-30 µA. Datasheet method (Sec 8.2.2.11, Type 2A network: R4 in series with C5 from COMP to GND, optional C8 COMP to GND): Eq.44 fp(mod) = IOUT(max) / (2 pi x VOUT x COUT); Eq.45 fz(mod) = 1 / (2 pi x RESR x COUT); Eq.46 fco = sqrt(fp(mod) x fz(mod)); Eq.47 fco = sqrt(fp(mod) x fSW/2); µse the lower of Eq.46/Eq.47 as the initial crossover; Eq.48 R4 = (2 pi x fco x COUT / gmps) x (VOUT / (VREF x gmea)); Eq.49 C5 = 1 / (2 pi x R4 x fp(mod)); Eq.50 C8 = COUT x RESR / R4; Eq.51 C8 = 1 / (R4 x fSW x pi); µse the larger of Eq.50/51 for C8 (optional compensation pole). Use derated COUT. The method ignores slope compensation (actual fco ends up lower) and assumes fco lies between fp(mod) and fz(mod), with fz >= 10 x fp. Example (5 V, 3.5 A, 600 kHz, COUT 2x47 µF derated to 58.3 µF, RESR 2.5 mOhm): fp 1912 Hz, fz 1092 kHz, fco 23.9 kHz, R4 = 13.0k, C5 = 6800 pF (6404 calc), C8 = 39 pF. Type 1 (C2 only) or Type 2B are alternatives (Fig 30). Type 1 suits high-ESR electrolytic/tantalum output caps.

extras.note: A resistor is required (no default/float frequency). Eq.7: RT(kΩ) = 101756 / fSW(kHz)^1.008 gives 193.6k for 500 kHz, so µse E96 196k (Eq.8 fSW = 92417 / RT^0.991 gives about 494 kHz). The EC table specifies RT = 200k as 500 kHz typ (450-550). Range 100-2500 kHz. Check fSW against Eq.9 (min on-time pulse skip) and Eq.10 (foldback, divide by 8). Can sync to an external clock (160-2300 kHz).

notes: Asynchronous: needs an external Schottky catch diode SW to GND. Peak-current-mode, external compensation on COMP.
Internal soft-start: 1024 switching cycles, tSS(ms) = 1024 / fSW(kHz) (Eq.6), 2.1 ms at 500 kHz (10-90%). No SS pin.
RHS = RLS x (VOUT - 0.8 V)/0.8 V (Eq.3). The example µses RLS = 10.2k, RHS = 53.6k for 5 V. Divider current must be > 1 µA, so RLS < 800 kΩ.

Inductor: LO(min) = (VIN(max) - VOUT)/(IOUT x KIND) x VOUT/(VIN(max) x fSW) (Eq.28). KIND up to 0.3 for ceramic COUT, 0.2 for higher-ESR caps. Ripple must stay > 150 mA for stable PWM. Conservative choice: Isat >= switch current limit (5.5 A nominal).

COUT from three criteria: Eq.32 COUT > 2 x dIOUT / (fSW x dVOUT); Eq.33 overshoot COUT > LO x (IOH^2 - IOL^2)/(Vf^2 - Vi^2); Eq.34 ripple COUT > 1/(8 fSW) x 1/(VORIPPLE/IRIPPLE); Eq.35 RESR < VORIPPLE/IRIPPLE. Use derated values.

Design example (Fig. 34) is at 600 kHz, not 500 kHz: 5 V/3.5 A, VIN 8.5-60 V, RT 162k, L 8.2 µH (WE 7447797820), COUT 2 x 47 µF 10 V ceramic, CIN 2 x 2.2 µF 100 V, D1 B560C, Cboot 0.1 µF, UVLO 523k/84.5k, FB 53.6k/10.2k, COMP 13.0k + 6800 pF // 39 pF.
Input: X5R/X7R ceramic with at least 3 µF EFFECTIVE (after DC bias), rated above VIN max. The example µses 2 x 2.2 µF 100 V. Bulk is optional.

BOOT: 0.1 µF X5R/X7R, >= 10 V. 100% duty capable while BOOT-SW > 2.1 V; an integrated LS FET recharges BOOT (disabled above 24 V output). Min VIN (Eq.1): VIN(min) = (VOUT + VF + Rdc x IOUT)/0.99 - VF + RDS(on) x IOUT.
Current limit 5.5 A typ (4.5 min, 6.8 max, open loop). Min controllable on-time 135 ns typ. fSW(max skip) = 1/tON x (IO x Rdc + VOUT + Vd)/(VIN - IO x RDS(on) + Vd) (Eq.9).
Pulse-skip Eco-mode at light load. Catalog '500 kHz' is not an internal default: RT must be fitted.
